### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **7** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/driver-sql`, `@objectstack/driver-turso`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **19** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **4** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/index.ts`, `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/index.ts`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**28** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 41646a5788f5362a66527a287200f9832fb00602`.

⛔ **9** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **4** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/index.ts`, `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/index.ts`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `os serve (command, 34 pages)`
- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **154** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 41646a5788f5362a66527a287200f9832fb00602` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `c084de89036dc7b5a8dd7333a615617fc76bb745` — the merge of head `82c14dd8f6cf6871d77b99091016678a8cab17ea` into base `41646a5788f5362a66527a287200f9832fb00602`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin c084de89036dc7b5a8dd7333a615617fc76bb745 && git checkout c084de89036dc7b5a8dd7333a615617fc76bb745
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 41646a5788f5362a66527a287200f9832fb00602 82c14dd8f6cf6871d77b99091016678a8cab17ea && git checkout -B drift-repro 41646a5788f5362a66527a287200f9832fb00602 && git merge --no-ff 82c14dd8f6cf6871d77b99091016678a8cab17ea

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 41646a5788f5362a66527a287200f9832fb00602
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 41646a5788f5362a66527a287200f9832fb00602` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `112ea8717bfd7bf4e1d1decdfac9d3a178298d1c`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts + packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts, packages/core/src/stack-auth.ts, packages/core/src/kernel.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/start.ts, packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts, packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/organizationless-counter-refusal.ts, packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/index.ts, packages/drivers/driver-turso/src/turso-driver.ts, packages/objectql/src/index.ts, packages/objectql/src/core.ts, packages/objectql/src/tenancy/system-write-organization.ts, packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts, packages/spec/src/system/constants/system-names.ts, packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts, .changeset/24583-7b3-organizationless-counter-retired.md, scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs, scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs, scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs, packages/cli/test/helpers/serve-process.ts, packages/cli/test/serve-no-auth-secret-refusal.integration.test.ts, packages/cli/test/serve-ready-degraded-boot.e2e.test.ts, packages/cli/test/uncreatable-directory-doors.integration.test.ts, packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-organizationless-counter-refusal.test.ts, packages/runtime/src/seed-tenancy-autonumber-split.integration.test.ts, packages/runtime/src/system-write-tenancy-autonumber-split.integration.test.ts, packages/objectql/src/system-write-organization.test.ts, packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts, packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts, docs/adr/0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md, docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md

Merge-base `307ce4c4b42503347d7f85825f572e4ca058b05f`; 24 files, +637/-88, as claimed. Read-only: the diff, the card comments 6284717698 / 6288405082, the PR body and the head's check-runs. Nothing built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

**1. The serve refusal — holds.**
- Exactly the case. `serve.ts:4682` refuses on `flags.server && !authComposition.composes && authComposition.reason === 'no-secret'`. `resolvePlatformAuthComposition` (`stack-auth.ts:168-184`) answers in order stack-supplies-auth, auth-tier-off, host-kernel, no-secret, so `no-secret` is reached only with the auth tier on, no stack-mounted AuthPlugin and not a host kernel. `--no-server` (`server` flag, `allowNo: true`, `serve.ts:1443`) drops `flags.server`; a dev boot composes through `resolveAuthSecret({ isDev })`'s fallback (`stack-auth.ts:145-148`, `isDevelopmentBoot` at 136); the host-kernel reason still only warns at `serve.ts:4160`. The A1 no-auth refusal at `serve.ts:4660` is untouched and the new block sits directly beside it in the same shape.
- Before any write. The throw is inside the composition phase: `ObjectKernel.use()` (`kernel.ts:347-377`) only loads and registers plugin metadata under the `state !== 'idle'` guard, no install or start runs; `runtime.start()` is at `serve.ts:5402`. The runtime state file is written only by `writeRuntimeState` on bound-port publication (`serve.ts:1090-1111`), after start. The pin's refused leg asserts the SQLite file was never created and the control leg that it was.
- `os start` shares it by inheritance: it spawns `bin/run.js serve` (`start.ts:524-536`) and forces `NODE_ENV=production` when unset (`start.ts:472`). In practice `start` always hands the child `AUTH_SECRET` (`start.ts:315-317`, `readOrCreateAuthSecret` persisting one under the home dir, then `start.ts:456`), so a `start` child never reaches the refusal. True, but vacuous; noted, not a defect.
- Prescriptive: the message names `OS_AUTH_SECRET`, `--no-server` and `os dev` / `os serve --dev`.
- No mistaken refusal. `resolveAuthSecret` reads only `OS_AUTH_SECRET` and its two legacy spellings via `readEnvWithDeprecation`, after dotenv-flow has loaded the project's `.env` files (`serve.ts:2360` precedes `4139`), plus the dev fallback. There is no secret-file or other resolver in the tree (grep over core, cli, plugin-auth), and AuthPlugin itself reads the same environment (`auth-manager.ts:4647`). A deployment that would have composed auth before this PR still composes; the only boots now refused are the ones that previously skipped AuthPlugin with the warning — the exact door 6284717698 measured.
- Forced and correct: `serve-no-auth-secret-refusal.integration.test.ts` spawns `bin/run.js` with `NODE_ENV: undefined` through `childEnv`, which is precisely the population `check-cli-test-child-env.mjs` pins (13 to 14), and its entry sits in sorted position (`serve-mcp-stdio-early-initialize` before it, `serve-no-storage-boot-guard` after, `scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs:2667-2672`). `E2E_AUTH_SECRET` (`serve-process.ts:803`) is forced for `uncreatable-directory-doors` (a production server rig whose property is `OS_HOME`), and `serve-ready-degraded-boot.e2e.test.ts` moving to `--no-server` (`:101`) is the only remaining way to reach a production degraded boot; its assertions at `:172-213` are unchanged.

**2. The counter refusal — holds, with the per-driver edge named below.**
- The flag. `organizationObjectRegistered` (`sql-driver.ts:5717`) is set in `computeAndRecordTenantField` (`:12169`) on `key === SystemObjectName.ORGANIZATION` and never cleared. Every registration door funnels there: `registerManagedObjectMetadata` (`:12342`, keyed by `StorageNameMapping.resolveTableName`, which is the identity for `sys_organization` since the name carries no `__` — `system-names.ts:287-290`), `registerExternalObject` (`:12245`, keyed by object name), the shard path (`:12083`, the base table), and Turso's remote `initObjects` and `registerObjectMetadata` (`turso-driver.ts:4143-4165`, `:4221-4224`) reach the same two. `resolveSequenceTenantId` (`:7797-7807`) orders no-tenant-column to `GLOBAL_TENANT`, carried organization to itself, registered to the throw, else `GLOBAL_TENANT`; it runs before `ensureSequencesTable` (`:8165`), and in `resyncSequenceToDataMax` (`:8426`) and `autoNumberCounterKey` (`:8465`); Turso's remote face at `:2780` and `:2883`. One throw site, both faces.
- Can a served composition see it false on a tenant table? Only for a DIRECT driver write (a) on a driver instance that never registers `sys_organization` — a secondary datasource, or a lean embedding — or (b) on the primary before `sys_organization`'s registration reaches it. Engine writes never depend on the flag: `resolveSystemInsertOrganization` derives under `single` and refuses otherwise whenever the engine holds the object (ADR-0131 D9), and the ObjectQL plugin registers every object on its driver at `start()` (`plugin.ts:1949-1953`, `:2015`) before application seeds. No system object declares an autonumber (grep over platform-objects, plugin-auth, organizations), so no served plugin reaches (a) or (b). Acceptable as the declared edge (open question 2, option A); see residual R1 for the follow-up shape.
- Code and status. `ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED` is listed under `@objectstack/driver-sql` (`error-code-ledger.zod.ts:1467`) beside the objectql row (`:778`); one code per emitting package is the ledger's own provenance convention (the `INVALID_METADATA` note at `:764-768` says so). 500 matches the engine twin (`status = 500`, `httpStatus = 500`, `system-write-organization.ts:335-337`) and the caller class — server-side code that bypassed the engine, never a client's bad input — so an HTTP door answers the same number whichever layer caught it.

**3. `GLOBAL_TENANT` un-exported — the removal is declared, the ADR-0087 marker is the wrong category.**
- Removed from the main entry only (`objectql/src/index.ts:553`); `core.ts` never exported it. No importer remains in the workspace: the four `GLOBAL_TENANT` importers read it from `@objectstack/driver-sql` or `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`; objectui has none.
- The changeset declares the removal in its BREAKING body and gives a remedy. But it rides `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. ADR-0087's seventh category (Addendum 2026-10-12, D9, `0087:983-1095`) exists for exactly this class — "a published runtime EXPORT retirement" — and closes with "The changeset itself is merged and is not re-graded: it stays on `no-migration-prescription`. New retirements use this category." The catch-all is admitted here only by the detector miss D9 names: the body's arrowless remedy line ("An import of `GLOBAL_TENANT` from `@objectstack/objectql`: import it from `@objectstack/driver-sql` … or spell `'__global__'`") is a FROM/TO rewrite the prescription detector cannot read. The marker's own text concedes the shape ("The one export removed … the remedy for it is stated below"). So "not-required (no-migration-prescription)" is not right for a removed export — B1.

**4. Texts — hold.** The `field.zod.ts` hunk is the `UniqueScopeSchema` TSDoc (`:693-716`), not a `.describe()`: no JSON-schema or docs artifact derives from it (the generated `object.mdx` tables carry `DeclaredIndexSchema.unique`'s describe at `object.zod.ts:566`, untouched and still true of the COALESCE emitters; the retired phrase survives only in CHANGELOGs). In the touched source no false statement about `__global__` remains: each site now says residue / 17.x / "wherever the organization object is registered". Over-broad or stale prose outside the surface is listed as residual R3.

**5. Tests — hold.** `system-write-organization.test.ts:318-322` and `system-write-tenancy-autonumber-split.integration.test.ts:198-204` turn `toContain('__global__')` into `not.toContain` plus positive `ADR-0131 D9` / `organization_id = NULL` assertions, the runtime one also pinning the engine's own prefix; `data-model-rules.unique-verdicts.test.ts` swaps the phrase for the new one plus `ADR-0131 D9`; `seed-tenancy-autonumber-split`'s `asA17xDriver` withholds the flag only after asserting it was set. Nothing weakened. The ablation claim is consistent with the code: removing the throw at `sql-driver.ts:7805` reds exactly the two refusal cases (create, bulkCreate) and leaves the carried / no-tenant-column / lean-embedding cases green.

**6. Semver and Clause-② — the line holds, one level does not.** `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` on the PR body and in the changeset; BREAKING banner; cli, driver-sql and objectql `minor`; lint and spec `patch` (texts and an additive ledger row). `@objectstack/driver-turso` is `patch` while the BREAKING bullet names its remote face's narrowing and its `src/**` moved — B2. `check-changeset-no-major` passes only through its "at least one moved package at minor+" quantifier, whose residual the gate itself prints ("it cannot catch a PR that … grades one `minor` and the other `patch`", `check-changeset-no-major.mjs:964-969`).

**CI at review time.** 25 success, 7 skipped, 0 failed; 8 still running: Test Core 1/6–6/6, Type Check · workspace, Type Check · consumer gates. Required-check status is therefore not yet final; nothing red.

### ② Semver level

`minor` with BREAKING under the launch-window convention (ADR-0087, amended 2026-09-13): correct for cli, driver-sql, objectql. driver-turso must be `minor` too (B2). The fixed group bumps as one, so the version outcome is unchanged; the declaration is what is wrong.

### ③ Boundary flags

**B1 — ADR-0087 marker category (changeset).** Replace the marker with the seventh category, naming the retired export: `adr-0087: not-required (runtime-export-retired @objectstack/objectql#GLOBAL_TENANT) …` with the why. Predicates as the gate checks them: 1 retired-from-entry (`index.ts` no longer exports it, `core.ts` never did, the merge base did); 2 no-metadata-surface (declared in `packages/objectql/src/tenancy/system-write-organization.ts`, not a `*.zod.ts`, not under `spec/src/contracts/`); 3 the inherited prescription refusal — the remedy line is prose with no arrow or framed table, and its FROM operand is the named export. Keep the "no key of any metadata schema is removed" sentence as the why; drop the claim that `no-migration-prescription` is the disposition.

**B2 — `@objectstack/driver-turso: patch` in the same changeset.** Grade it `minor`: its remote face refuses what it used to accept (`turso-driver.ts:2780`, `:2883`), its `src/**` moved, and the BREAKING bullet names it. One-line fix in the same file as B1.

**Residuals (not blocking).**
- R1 — the composition fact is per driver instance and read at write time, so a direct driver write on a tenant table keys `__global__` wherever that instance has not (yet) registered `sys_organization`: a secondary datasource, a lean embedding, or the primary before its registration. Engine writes are covered. Acceptable now (no served direct-driver autonumber writer exists); if one appears, open question 2's option B — the engine or the boot handing the fact to every driver as an option — is the robust shape, and the module header should say the fact is "registered on this instance", not "composed".
- R2 — `serve-no-auth-secret-refusal.integration.test.ts:66` unsets only `OS_AUTH_SECRET`; `resolveAuthSecret` also reads `AUTH_SECRET` and `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET`, and `childEnv` passes the parent environment through (it strips only vitest keys and `NODE_PATH`, `serve-process.ts:858-889`). A shell exporting a legacy spelling turns the refused leg red. Add both legacy names as `undefined` to the boot env.
- R3 — prose outside the surface that still describes the 17.x write as current, for the seat (docs are off the release gate, ADR-0131 scope note 4): `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx:1801` and `content/docs/deployment/seed-tenancy-repair.mdx:305` ("about to mint more duplicates"); `content/docs/protocol/objectql/schema.mdx:609-611` ("every row on a single-organization deployment" carries no organization). Inside the surface, two nits: `rule-explanations.ts:2687-2689` and `data-model-rules.ts:595-597` say "since ADR-0131 D9 a new row carries its organization" without the "wherever the organization object is registered" hedge the TSDoc and the module header carry (false for the lean embedding this PR keeps by design); `error-code-ledger.zod.ts:773-775` still says the fork "forks the autonumber counter" in the present tense — a why-comment, tolerable.
- R4 — `os start` cannot reach the refusal because it always supplies a secret (`start.ts:315-317`, `:456`); the claim "`os start` shares it" is true by inheritance only. No change asked.
- R5 — CI: the eight running check-runs above must reach success before merge.

Correction to the PR body, answering contract review 6288633042 (R4). The body says "`os start` spawns `serve`, so it gets the same refusal". That is wrong: `os start` always supplies a secret to the `serve` child it spawns, so it never reaches the refusal. The changeset now says so (commit 82c14dd8).

- **B2:** `@objectstack/driver-turso` is graded `minor`.
- **R2:** the refusal pin also unsets the legacy `AUTH_SECRET` and `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET`.

`main` is merged again at ef624ed4, bringing in 7a-1 and 7c.

### ① Derived judgments

**B1 — resolved.** The marker now reads `adr-0087: not-required (runtime-export-retired @objectstack/objectql#GLOBAL_TENANT)` followed by the why, which keeps the "no key of any metadata schema is removed, renamed or re-shaped" sentence and no longer calls `no-migration-prescription` the disposition. Checked against the gate as it reads a marker:
- the operand parses (`parseExportOperand`: a `PACKAGE_NAME_RE` package, `#`, a plain export name; the package, not a file, as D9 requires);
- predicate 1, retired-from-entry: `@objectstack/objectql` is published (`private` unset), its `exports["."].types` is `./dist/index.d.ts`, so the entry is `src/index.ts`; at the base `7c2eab929` it exports `GLOBAL_TENANT` (`index.ts:553`), at HEAD `GLOBAL_TENANT` is absent from every non-test file under `packages/objectql/src`, and the entry carries no `export *` at either rev, so absence is provable;
- predicate 2, no-metadata-surface: the base declaration is `packages/objectql/src/tenancy/system-write-organization.ts` (`metadataSurfaceKind` null), a `const`, not a Zod projection; a word-match scan over every `*.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/contracts/**`, `*.object.ts` and `**/objects/*.ts` at the base finds no `GLOBAL_TENANT` (the homonyms in driver-sql, driver-turso and metadata-protocol live outside those surfaces, and `GLOBAL_TENANT_KEY` in `generate.ts` is a different word);
